subject.title: [Bug]: 401 The API key format is incorrect

question: For a UUID-style Volcengine Lite/Coding Plan key, should OpenClaw route DeepSeek usage through a coding-plan model or endpoint, keep the current general DeepSeek row and improve diagnostics, or add a separate explicit Lite-plan path?
rationale: The current code supports both general and coding Volcengine providers from one key, but the issue evidence does not prove which vendor endpoint or model set accepts Lite-plan keys, and changing provider routing can affect existing Volcengine users.

options.title: Live-confirm then route/document Lite behavior
options.body: Use a credentialed Lite key to decide the supported model refs, then update the Volcengine plugin catalog, docs, and tests for that route.

options.title: Keep current routing and improve diagnostics
options.body: Leave general DeepSeek on the general endpoint and add clearer setup or runtime guidance when a Lite key is used against the wrong entitlement.

options.title: Close as unsupported without code change
options.body: Treat Lite-plan keys as outside the currently supported Volcengine model contract unless maintainers want to sponsor that route.

recommendation.title: Live-confirm then route/document Lite behavior
recommendation.body: Use a credentialed Lite key to decide the supported model refs, then update the Volcengine plugin catalog, docs, and tests for that route.

likelyOwner.reason: The provider auth alias and recent Volcengine plugin history make this the best available routing owner, with `shakkernerd` as catalog-history context.
